You can review the eligible cases where Amazon can remove or strikethrough comments, but in essence you are correct that if the entire comment is a product review, with no reflection on services provided by the seller, it may be eligible for removal.

In your listed comments though, it appears they all do contain indications that items were damaged, defective, missing parts, or made of poor quality.
